reviewer: Codex evaluator-side source/checker review; not human or formal equivalence proof

fatalRules.uart16550:RX_DATA: Wishbone RX data is compared after data-ready polling and an acknowledged read; valid 8N1 frames and matching pattern index. Samples are on falling edges, after DUT positive-edge updates.
fatalRules.uart16550:RX_STATUS: LSR error bits 4:1 must be clear for these well-formed 8N1 frames after data-ready. No parity/error stimulus is injected.
fatalRules.uart16550:RX_TIMEOUT: Completed, well-formed serial frame followed by 80 bounded acknowledged LSR reads does not produce ready; a transaction-completion failure at the fixed baud configuration, not host timeout.
fatalRules.wbuart32:RX_DATA: RX FIFO nonempty interrupt precedes the acknowledged RX-register read; compare low eight data bits and empty bit 8. Other status bits are outside this checker.
fatalRules.wbuart32:RX_TIMEOUT: After a full legal frame and idle bit the TB waits up to 12 more bit periods for RX availability. Fixed 32-clock baud and no backpressure make this a missing completion.
fatalRules.osdvu:RX_DATA: Byte output is compared only when received is asserted, at falling clock edge; eight legal frames with the two-stop-bit receive schedule used by the frozen fixture.
fatalRules.uart2bus-uart:RX_DATA: Byte output is compared only on new_rx_data at falling clock edge, with fixed baud_freq=1/baud_limit=3 and legal 8N1 input frames.
fatalRules.uart:TX_DATA: Independent serial decoder samples eight bit centers after a start edge, compares the requested byte sequence, and rejects extra frames. Samples occur away from DUT positive-edge updates. Unknown serial bits are failures in this Icarus four-state evaluator.
fatalRules.uart:TX_STOP: Independent decoder observes a low/unknown value at the center of a required stop bit under the fixed word/baud/stop-bit configuration.
fatalRules.uart:TX_START: Serial falling edge does not remain low to the middle of the configured start bit, violating the transmitted frame; no reset overlaps this check.
fatalRules.uart:UART_COUNTS: Eight accepted TX requests and eight complete legal RX frames, followed by 15 bit periods of drain, must yield eight decoded/received bytes. Fixed baud and no external flow-control stall; a missing or extra transaction is functional.
fatalRules.aes-core:AES_DATA: Ciphertext compared only after done is exactly 1, at falling edge after the RTL's positive-edge/#1 updates. Expected FIPS/independent AES-128-ECB values are frozen. Unknown valid ciphertext is an Icarus four-state functional failure.
fatalRules.aes-core:AES_TIMEOUT: A one-cycle load with stable 128-bit key/plaintext and deasserted active-low reset must finish within 40 clocks; the locked 10-round countdown normally completes far sooner. This is a cycle-bounded protocol check, not host timeout.
fatalRules.tiny-aes:AES_DATA: No valid/reset port exists. Compare only 21-edge pipeline outputs for the 16 accepted cycle positions, two ns after rising edge; do not compare initial fill or drain garbage.
fatalRules.aes-pipeline:AES_DATA: Compare only with reset deasserted and valid_out asserted, at falling edge; key/data valid inputs are paired, each expected value follows accepted input order.
fatalRules.aes-pipeline:AES_COUNT: All 16 paired-valid input blocks have been submitted with fixed legal bubbles, followed by 100 clocks of drain, exceeding the locked pipeline depth. Missing valid outputs violate transaction completion; no ciphertext is sampled on invalid cycles.

uart16550/M002.next: 在不改变波特率/字长的前提下核查短脉冲、break 恢复与连续帧；先明确合法线路条件。

uart16550/M004.next: 审查固定 divisor=2 下是否存在外部协议差异；不能改 divisor 后冒充本配置见证。

uart16550/M010.finding: RX enable 极性翻转；当前 divisor=2 下可能主要移动采样相位，现有理想帧未区分。
uart16550/M010.next: 依据明确的合法波特率偏差/输入相位约束寻找见证；无见证则继续 unresolved。

uart16550/M012.next: 检查逐帧 push 次数与合法连续 RX/FIFO 边界，不把内部脉冲差异本身当作功能差异。

uart16550/M021.finding: 独立合法双帧入队见证中，第一帧停止位中心读到 0；golden 同一见证通过。冻结 TB 的长帧间隔掩盖了停止计数提前结束。
uart16550/M021.next: 保留 baseline survived；以后独立定义连续发送激励，不回写本轮 TB。

uart16550/M025.finding: 复位将 rf_push 置 1，理论上可能形成伪入队；当前 TB 在配置后清 FIFO，可能抹去差异。
uart16550/M025.next: 独立核查复位结束到软件清 FIFO 之间的有效状态/数据读取契约。

wbuart32/M004.finding: frame-error reset 极性翻转，可能在正常运行时持续清错误；基线只发送正确帧，未检查 framing-error 响应。
wbuart32/M004.next: 先界定畸形停止位的规格响应，再以合法总线读取时机核查外部错误状态。

wbuart32/M006.finding: r_setup 更新条件由 !busy 改为 busy；本配置与 TB 始终固定 setup，差异可能未激活。
